transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

Well… I almost didn’t come in, because I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is. But what scared me was… I keep having these thoughts that maybe it would be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t tried to hurt myself or anything like that. I just… I thought maybe I should tell someone. Is that okay to say?
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things the way you used to, or that you’ve lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yes… I guess I have noticed that. I used to really look forward to doing my watercolors, and I had a dance class, and I’d walk with the ladies sometimes. Lately I just… leave my paints sitting there, and I don’t go like I used to. It’s not that I’m trying to be difficult or lazy, I just can’t seem to make myself care much. Does that make sense?
Have you been feeling like you’re not worth much or that you’re a burden to others lately?

A little, yes… I don’t mean to sound dramatic. It’s just when I get tired or irritated with my aunt, I feel awful afterward. I start thinking I’m a bad woman, like I should be more grateful, and that maybe I’m bringing shame on my family. I know that probably sounds harsh… but that’s where my mind goes sometimes.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the time lately, even when there’s no clear reason for it?

Yes… I think so. I don’t want to overstate it, but most mornings I wake up with this heavy sadness in my chest, like I’ve already failed the day before it even starts. It’s silly maybe, because nothing has even happened yet, but that’s how it feels.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has this sadness and loss of interest been going on for most days over the past couple of weeks?

It’s been… longer than just a couple weeks, I think. Maybe about four months now, since my aunt came to live with us. I kept thinking it was just an adjustment and I should handle it better, but yes, most days it’s been there in some way. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you noticed that you feel more tired than usual or that even small tasks take a lot out of you lately?

Yes… I suppose I have. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but even if I’ve been in bed all night, my body still feels worn out. Little things, like making breakfast or carrying laundry, seem to take more out of me than they should. Is that what you mean?
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating much less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?

I… I don’t really know. I haven’t been keeping track, honestly. My clothes seem about the same, I think. Some days I don’t feel much like eating, but I couldn’t say there’s been any real weight change or anything. Is that okay to say if I’m not sure?
Have you noticed that your thoughts feel slowed down, or that even simple decisions, like what to wear or what to eat, take much longer than they used to?

A little, maybe. I don’t want to make too much of it, but my husband has said I move like everything takes extra effort now. And at the market I’ll stand there longer than I should, just trying to pick up the thing I came for. It feels silly saying it, but… yes, I guess simple things do take me longer sometimes.
Have you ever felt this way before, with similar sadness or loss of interest, or is this the first time you’ve experienced something like this?

I’m not really sure how to answer that. I’ve had down times before, I suppose, like anyone does, but I don’t know if it was quite like this. I don’t want to say something wrong… this feels a bit different, but I’m not sure if that means it’s the first time or not.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt down or lost interest in things for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

I don’t know that I can say for sure. I’ve had times where I was down, but… for most of the day, every day, for two weeks like that, I’m not sure. I wouldn’t want to exaggerate it. Does that answer it okay?
Have you ever had a time in your life before this when you felt down or lost interest in things for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

I’m sorry, I know you’re asking me straight, but I really don’t know. I’ve had sad spells before, sure, but whether it was most of the day, nearly every day, for two whole weeks… I can’t say for certain. I don’t want to make it sound like more than it was.
Can you think back and say if there was ever a time before this current period when you felt down or lost interest in things for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?

I’ve been trying to think back, and I honestly can’t say that I remember a time like that before. I’ve had low days, of course, but whether it was nearly every day for two weeks straight… I don’t think I can say yes to that. Is that okay to say?
Can you think of any other time in your life, before this current period, when you felt down or lost interest in things for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks straight?

No, I… I really can’t think of another time like that before this. I’ve had my share of feeling low here and there, but not something I can honestly say was most of the day, nearly every day, for two weeks straight. I hope that makes sense.
